dct_description_sm: Residents of Clearwater Lake in Sudbury have collected annual ice on and ice off dates for the lake since 2005. Clearwater Lake is on the outskirts of the City of Greater Sudbury. This data record contains annual ice on, ice off, and ice cover duration observations.
